title: YourMondayMotivator: Special powers
html:
Have you every watched a movie, or read a book, or been in a situation where you daydreamed about having a special power?

I'm going to going to go out on a limb here and say you have. Now what was the special power you wanted?

As a teenage boy it was probably Superman's x-ray vision and if you were a girl maybe Wonder Woman's bracelets.

On the weekend I watched the Time Travellers Wife and imagined for a few minutes if I was a time traveller (I'm a Dr Who fan as well) what would I want to do. See my Grandparents, win Lotto, meet Jesus, the list went on. I had a great time for a few minutes imagining all sorts of cool scenario's and was left feeling relaxed and really good.

How often do you daydream about having a special power? How often do you daydream? I recommend doing it at least once a week and letting your mind go completely wild.

Your mind is an incredible thing and you will be amazed at what comes out of being completely free with your imagination.

Now think about this. If you can be free imagining you with your special powers you can be creative and free with your goals and life.

I'll leave you with the thought that you can be anything you want to be.

Have a great week.
